description:
Compare source across exact package versions or public repository refs. Pass an unversioned canonical `target`, with endpoints in `from` and `to`. Package targets return repository-wide diffs: sibling paths may appear, and a bounded result with no package paths does not prove the package unchanged. The default `name-status` view is bounded inventory; use `stat` for magnitude or `patch` for content. In `text`, patch previews are bounded at 320 UTF-8 bytes; use `format: "json"` for the exact full returned patch, still subject to `max_patch_bytes` and backend content coverage. Incomplete, filtered, byte-escaped, omitted, or unavailable patch evidence is not authoritative or safely applicable. Raw diffs never prove compatibility or upgrade safety. Do not include credentials, personal data, private code, or proprietary content in inputs.

Load the GitHits guide once per session first (`quick_start` or the `githits-mcp` skill).

format.description: Omit for text. Use json only when code consumes raw fields or text lacks a required field. JSON includes the full returned patch.

from.description: Required starting package version or public repository ref.

max_files.description: Optional relevance-ranked returned-file bound from 1 through 300.

max_patch_bytes.description: Optional aggregate patch-byte bound from 1024 through 2097152; patch view only.

path_glob.description: Omit for all paths. Otherwise one non-empty repository-relative literal or glob. For several files use one shared glob such as **/*.js or lib/**/*.js; for unrelated named paths call once per path. Supports *, ?, whole-component ** and backslash escapes; no braces, character classes, ! or Git pathspec magic.

target.description: One unversioned compact target string such as `npm:express`, `github:expressjs/express`, or `launchpad:~owner/+git/repo` (`lp:PROJECT` also accepted). Do not embed a version or ref.

to.description: Required ending package version or public repository ref.

view.description: Projection: `name-status` (default, bounded inventory), `name-only`, `stat`, or `patch`. `max_patch_bytes` is valid only for `patch`.

name: code_diff
